skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-chatgpt-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up profit-based or revenue-based bidding for a Cloudflare website in ChatGPT Ads. Check tracking, configure cost estimates, and verify a test purchase before changing a campaign.
skill.summary: Set up and verify profit-based bidding for a Cloudflare website in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown notation, documentation links, or normal setup steps, not shell substitution or reconnaissance. The skill does direct live MCP requests and recommend an unpinned installer. The workflow also leaves gaps in credential handling, approval, remote instruction trust, and consent guidance.

remediation.issue: The agent workflow allows a Conversions API key to pass through the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception and require the user to enter the key directly in Product Metrics. Return only connection status and sanitized errors to the agent.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not require confirmation for all live Product Metrics writes.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only checks. Before a write, show the workspace, property, pixel, and expected effects, then obtain explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every permission.
remediation.suggestion: Document each required permission and why it is needed. Ask the administrator to verify the provider, account, and zone before granting access.

remediation.issue: The POAS guide does not restate the marketing-consent requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Document the combined marketing, analytics, and personalization rules in both guides. Verify that a test without marketing consent sends no ChatGPT Ads event.

remediation.issue: The installer and fallback operating instructions are not pinned.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill source to reviewed versions. Bundle reviewed instructions or verify a pinned copy before using it to guide authenticated operations.

remediation.issue: The workflow directs live calls to an external MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Use only a user-configured, verified Product Metrics connector. Limit the connector to the required permissions and send only data needed for the authorized action.

semantic_findings.title: Conversions API key may pass through the assistant
semantic_findings.description: The key-handling exception allows the assistant to obtain the merchant's Conversions API key and pass it to a command. This can expose the key in transcripts or tool logs, despite the reference telling merchants never to paste it into chat.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly names the OpenAI key and directs immediate command use. The skill provides no secure input channel for agent-assisted entry.

semantic_findings.title: Live configuration writes lack an explicit approval step
semantic_findings.description: The workflow assigns Product Metrics setup to the agent and requires explicit user action for campaign selection, but not for every live write. This leaves destination activation and cost changes without a consistent confirmation step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow describes authenticated writes and retries. The reference shows that adding a destination enables sending and activating costs changes the profit input.

semantic_findings.title: Cloudflare authorization advice encourages blanket approval
semantic_findings.description: Troubleshooting tells administrators to approve every requested permission. The integration adds tracking across the chosen domain, but the guide does not explain the requested permissions or their scope.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The blanket approval instruction and domain-wide effect are explicit. The files do not establish that the integration actually requests unnecessary permissions.

semantic_findings.title: Profit event guide omits the marketing-consent gate
semantic_findings.description: The profit guide explains delivery without personalization consent but omits the separate marketing gate described by the connector guide. An operator could mistake an opt-out marker for permission to send an event without marketing consent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The connector guide explicitly requires marketing consent, while the profit guide lists analytics and personalization rules. The files do not show a runtime consent bypass.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable web instructions can replace reviewed setup steps
semantic_findings.description: If local references are absent, the skill directs the agent to use live vendor pages as workflow instructions. Changes to those pages could alter how the agent performs authenticated setup without changing this skill revision.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback explicitly substitutes live Markdown for bundled instructions without a version or integrity check. No evidence of tampering was found.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding for ChatGPT Ads on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Revenue-based targets can hide campaigns that lose money after product costs and fees. Use Product Metrics to track order profit and verify the conversion before changing your campaign.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify the remaining steps for the selected website.
Guide Cloudflare gateway setup, storefront linking, and the ChatGPT Ads connection.
Explain how the product cost fallback, fees, and shipping affect reported profit.
Guide verification of a test order and the profit event in Product Metrics and Ads Manager.
Compare profit and revenue conversion events and explain how to choose a starting target.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare hostname, and the appropriate workspace and Ads Manager access.
Cloudflare Tracking does not supply item-level costs, so estimated profit depends on the fallback rate and additional costs you enter.
ChatGPT Ads does not import historical orders or revise events for later refunds.
The user authorizes Cloudflare access and changes the campaign conversion in Ads Manager.

use_cases.title: Check connection requirements
use_cases.description: Identify which Cloudflare, Product Metrics, and ChatGPT Ads steps are needed before a first test purchase.

use_cases.title: Pilot a profit-based campaign
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit targets, then prepare one campaign to use the verified profit event.

use_cases.title: Investigate missing profit events
use_cases.description: Review delivery status, consent, and cost settings when revenue events arrive but profit events do not.

prompt_templates.title: Check prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a Cloudflare website and want to know what setup requires.
prompt_templates.prompt: List the prerequisites for profit bidding in ChatGPT Ads for my Cloudflare website. Do not make changes or ask for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a test order
prompt_templates.scenario: You connected the website and ad destination.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me verify whether my consented test order produced a profit event. Use read-only checks and tell me where to confirm it in Ads Manager.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose missing profit
prompt_templates.scenario: The revenue event arrives, but the profit event is missing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether the missing profit event could be caused by incomplete costs, missing consent, or a delivery error. List recommended changes for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a campaign pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: You know the current profit on ad spend for a campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: My campaign has a measured profit on ad spend of 1.5. Compare profit and revenue bidding, suggest a starting target, and outline checks before switching. Leave the campaign unchanged.

output_examples.input: My test order arrived with revenue but no profit. What should I check?
output: Check whether the product cost fallback and all additional costs are active.
Confirm the banner recorded marketing and analytics consent for the purchase.
After correcting the missing requirement, place a new test order and check whether Ads Manager receives the profit event.

output_examples.input: What target should I start with if my current profit on ad spend is 1.5?
output: Use 150% as an initial target on the profit conversion, not a guarantee.
Confirm the profit event is arriving before selecting it for one campaign in Ads Manager.
Review the campaign after a few weeks before adjusting the target.

best_practices: Enter the Conversions API key in the Product Metrics app, not in chat.
Confirm the hostname, property, and pixel before approving tracking changes.
Verify the consent rules and cost inputs, then confirm a test profit event before changing a campaign.
anti_patterns: Treating a revenue target as equivalent to a profit target.
Changing the campaign before a test order produces a profit event.
Assuming an ad personalization opt-out replaces the marketing and analytics consent checks.

faq.question: What is the difference between POAS and ROAS?
faq.answer: Profit on ad spend compares order profit with ad spend. Return on ad spend compares order revenue with ad spend.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. This workflow uses Cloudflare Tracking on a proxied hostname and reads purchases from the order confirmation page.

faq.question: How is profit estimated without item costs?
faq.answer: Product Metrics applies your fallback cost percentage to each line's revenue. It also subtracts configured costs such as shipping and fees.

faq.question: Where should I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Create it in Ads Manager and enter it directly in the Product Metrics connection form. Do not share it in chat.

faq.question: Why did the purchase arrive without a profit event?
faq.answer: The order may lack a complete cost calculation or analytics consent. Confirm marketing consent as well, since it is required for delivery.

faq.question: Who changes the campaign conversion?
faq.answer: You select the profit conversion in Ads Manager after verifying delivery from a test order. The skill guides the change without switching the campaign.
